assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome, requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, this Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The patient may have paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The authorization was absent, so the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
The patient should submit a formal appeal request along with any supporting clinical documentation within the timeframe specified in the member handbook.
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
